extracted.name: Banana Bread Easy Peasy
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cups melted butter or vegetable oil
you may add 1tsp cinnamon and 1tsp nutmeg powder as you like
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven 200 c. Mashed the bananas and put all ingredients in a bowl. Mix until all blended together. Put the mixture in your baking pan/ loaf. Wait approximately 30 to 40 minutes until its done.
